CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2813 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head bd88bca13ce433d838432184320a2ce9eea9bc6f. Bus nonce: 83cca341bfcb9cf4f214f53e190a2e1b. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin bd88bca13ce433d838432184320a2ce9eea9bc6f`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge bd88bca13ce433d838432184320a2ce9eea9bc6f` or `Fix review: blocked bd88bca13ce433d838432184320a2ce9eea9bc6f <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 83cca341bfcb9cf4f214f53e190a2e1b`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `bd88bca13ce433d838432184320a2ce9eea9bc6f` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2813 bd88bca13ce433d838432184320a2ce9eea9bc6f") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2813-83cca341`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Review #2813 (triage batch 24, dev/programme/triage/s6-batch24.md, rulings P111 to P122, all ACCEPT) against dev/governance/roles/proposal-triage.md. For each ruling check: ACCEPT names a destination; `Source:`, `Instances:` (every counted instance carries the command or log reference beside its figure, and you re-run or re-derive at least one per ruling), `Cost:` and `Binding:`; an unmeasured benefit may not be ACCEPT; an even trade is REJECT.
Carry destinations (the main check): for every ruling's destination group, read the roster at origin/main and confirm it is a LIVE group (exists, not done, not absorbed) with nothing merging or in the merge train spool. A destination whose pull request is merging, has a MERGE verdict, or sits in the train spool is closing and counts as done for a new carry. The orchestrator's merge-STATE.md lists what is merging now: batch 4 carries #2712 (R10-DEMAND-OVERBOOK) and #2807, and R10-PARAMS-OWNER has a pull request about to open. P115 (R10-BUFFER-STORE) and P117 (R10-SAV-ACTUATION) refer to those; confirm the carry text is sound given them. The destinations to verify: R10-FLOW-DESIGN-STAGES (P111), R10-TRAIN-OVERLAP-GRADE (P112), R10-COP-GATE (P113, P114), R10-BUFFER-STORE (P115, P116), R10-SAV-ACTUATION (P117), R10-HEAT-METER (P118, P121), R10-DIAG-REDACT (P119), R10-LEGIONELLA-COMPLETION (P120, a NEW group: check the roster branch or the ruling states how it is created and that it does not duplicate an existing group), R10-HOUSE-GRADE (P122).
P122 must cite `9d984a63b` (the roster commit that created R10-HOUSE-GRADE): check the commit exists on origin and does create that group, and that P122's text cites it.
Also check: the body's verdict figure matches the file (12 ACCEPT, 0 DEFER, 0 REJECT); the pull request changes only the batch file and its delivery row dev/programme/delivery/2813.md; no host or home path appears. Report a ruling you would change, with the evidence, and say merge or blocked.
No host or home paths in anything you push; cite repo-relative paths only.
